note: Declared faults for the mutation adequacy measurement of the NENRIN provenance corpora. Each fault is one exact text substitution (anchor -> replacement) in one function of the Python port. The anchor must occur exactly once in the file. Controls are not faults: the positive control must be killed or the run has no score, the inert control must move nothing or the run is void.

faults.label: F1 grant signature check removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2b: caller_sig verifies under grant.caller_id

faults.label: F2 receipt signature check removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2b and 2d: provider_sig verifies under the receipt's provider_id (2b) and under grant.provider_id (2d)

faults.label: F3 wrong key accepted at step 2b
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2b: caller_sig verifies under the key of grant.caller_id and provider_sig under the key of receipt.provider_id. NENRIN identities are did:key, so the key is resolved from the named signer; there is no separate kid. The fault is trial verification: a signature is accepted if it verifies under the key of any party of the pair, not the key of the party the record names.

faults.label: F4 validity window check removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2a and step 3: executed_at (declared_at) is inside [not_before, not_after] (outside_authorization_window)

faults.label: F4b (refinement of F4) not_after bound ignored
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2a and step 3: the instant is not after not_after. Added because F4 is killed by one vector only, which tests the not_before side; this asks whether the corpora test the other side.
faults.anchor: if v is None or t > v:

faults.label: F5 action match removed (E1 on the receipt)
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2a E1: canonical(grant.action) equals canonical(receipt.executed_action) (action_diverged)

faults.label: F6a grant_ref recompute check removed
F6c receipt.grant_ref binding check removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2a: receipt.grant_ref equals the recomputed grant_ref (receipt_unbound)

faults.label: F7 strict RFC3339 UTC check removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2a and step 3, section 5: executed_at / declared_at / not_before / not_after are strict RFC3339 UTC instants on a real calendar day (invalid_timestamp)

faults.label: F8 incomplete pair accepted
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2: a grant with an empty receipt set, or receipts with no grant, is refusal execution_incomplete_pair
faults.anchor: refuse("execution_incomplete_pair", "a grant and at least one receipt are both required to verify execution")

faults.label: F9 action_binding digest comparison removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md section 2 (AB): an action_binding, when carried, must recompute: digest.value equals sha256(canonical(action)) (action_binding_mismatch). args_sha256 has no comparison of its own: it is a member of the action and is compared only inside E1 (F5) and inside this digest.
faults.anchor: if nullish(prop(rec, key)) or prop(d, "value") != action_digest(prop(rec, key)):

faults.label: F10 executor authorization (E3) removed
faults.rule: VERIFIER.md step 2a and step 3: grant.provider_id is null or equals receipt.provider_id / intent.provider_id (provider_not_authorized). Chosen because it is the rule that a receipt comes from the executor the caller authorized, and a validly signed receipt from a different provider is the attack it stops.
faults.anchor:
def provider_authorized(g, r):
    return nullish(prop(g, "provider_id")) or seq(prop(r, "provider_id"), prop(g, "provider_id"))

controls.label: CONTROL positive: verifier always accepts
controls.rule: must be killed: every refusal is dropped and the verdict is always accepted

controls.label: CONTROL inert: equivalent UTF-8 encoding call in sha256hex
controls.rule: must move nothing: str.encode("utf-8") and bytes(s, "utf-8") give the same bytes, and the line runs on every vector
